paragraphs: R' La—Layya. See the entry R' Ila'i.[^1]

notes.text: The supplied heading is לא—לייא and the target אלעאי. La—Layya and Ila’i are conventional vocalizations; La is a name transliteration here, not a translation as the negative “no.” Earlier machine OCR had ליא instead of the supplied לייא. Both titles remain R'.
